title: BASALT pure trusted-state transition reference model
claim_ceiling: Deterministic state-machine conformance for revision-bound transitions, receipt idempotency, source generation continuity, policy monotonicity and log-checkpoint progression. This benchmark does not execute cryptography, a durable storage backend, a remote anti-rollback anchor, witness consensus, or observer/close qualification.

scenarios.invariant: Pinned first-use checkpoint and generation-1 source cursor
scenarios.expected: Commit log cursor, source cursor, policy versions and receipt record in one model state revision

scenarios.invariant: Retry exact previously accepted DSSE-envelope digest and exact semantic bindings
scenarios.expected: Return already-committed without advancing revision

scenarios.invariant: Two plans previewed from the same state revision race to commit
scenarios.expected: Exactly one plan commits; the other receives compare conflict

scenarios.invariant: After a stale compare conflict, retry the exact same receipt against newer state
scenarios.expected: Discover the exact accepted receipt and return already-committed

scenarios.invariant: Candidate skips one source generation
scenarios.expected: Reject generation gap

scenarios.invariant: Checkpoint at same tree size presents a different Merkle root
scenarios.expected: Reject checkpoint fork

scenarios.invariant: Candidate presents smaller transparency tree size
scenarios.expected: Reject stale checkpoint

scenarios.invariant: Candidate presents malformed consistency-proof digest reference
scenarios.expected: Reject malformed proof reference

scenarios.invariant: Observer profile digest changes without transition authorization
scenarios.expected: Reject unauthorized profile transition without new cursor

scenarios.invariant: Observer profile changes with explicit transition evidence at next generation
scenarios.expected: Prepare successor on the same stable cursor

scenarios.invariant: Boot incarnation changes without transition authorization
scenarios.expected: Reject unauthorized boot transition

scenarios.invariant: Boot incarnation changes with explicit transition evidence at next generation
scenarios.expected: Prepare successor without resetting source generation

scenarios.invariant: Signer policy version decreases
scenarios.expected: Reject policy rollback

scenarios.invariant: A previously accepted receipt digest is reused with different semantics
scenarios.expected: Reject receipt digest collision/equivocation

scenarios.invariant: Candidate was verified against a stale state revision
scenarios.expected: Reject compare conflict and require re-verification

scenarios.invariant: Two independent source streams preview against the same log checkpoint and state revision; the loser must re-read, re-verify and rebase
scenarios.expected: Both source cursors commit in sequence; the shared log checkpoint has no lost update

scenarios.invariant: Sixteen threads concurrently attempt the same prepared state plan
scenarios.expected: Exactly one commit succeeds and fifteen receive compare conflicts

scenarios.invariant: A plan prepared against a state snapshot is submitted to a divergent snapshot with the same revision number
scenarios.expected: Reject StateSnapshotMismatch and leave the divergent snapshot byte-for-byte/field-for-field unchanged

scenarios.invariant: Existing source changes its transparency-log origin without continuity evidence
scenarios.expected: Reject UnauthorizedLogOriginTransition and leave source cursor/log cursors unchanged

scenarios.invariant: Existing source changes log origin with explicit continuity evidence and a separately pinned new-log bootstrap checkpoint
scenarios.expected: Advance the same stable source cursor to the next generation and retain both old and new log checkpoints
